findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_scoreboard" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: record_content, list_feed, get_seo, get_claims, get_move, adopt_move_result, dismiss_gap, report_job · Private data: record_content, list_kb_pages, get_kb_page, record_claim, set_voice_axes, record_voice_rule, record_profile, accept_move, ship_move, set_output_status, disconnect_connection, record_insight · Public sink: record_content, get_visibility, record_claim, set_voice_axes, undo_move, propose_move, report_job · Destructive: get_experiments, whoami, get_enrollment, get_snapshot, record_voice_rule, refresh_scan, replenish_feed, disconnect_connection, untrack_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: record_content, list_feed, get_seo, get_claims, get_move, adopt_move_result, dismiss_gap, report_job · Private data: record_content, list_kb_pages, get_kb_page, record_claim, set_voice_axes, record_voice_rule, record_profile, accept_move, ship_move, set_output_status, disconnect_connection, record_insight · Public sink: record_content, get_visibility, record_claim, set_voice_axes, undo_move, propose_move, report_job · Destructive: get_experiments, whoami, get_enrollment, get_snapshot, record_voice_rule, refresh_scan, replenish_feed, disconnect_connection, untrack_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
